composition_variation: Create a clean coastal anime illustration of Shinnosuke Nohara sitting on broad pale stone steps above a quiet beach. He is fully dressed in a blue-and-white striped shirt, yellow shorts, sandals, and a straw sunhat resting behind his head. His thick eyebrows and playful cheek shape stay recognizable. He gently holds one small paper pinwheel upright, with relaxed fingers. Use ultramarine sea bands, turquoise shallows, coral pinwheel accents, soft white clouds, and tranquil midday light. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
